title: Systems vaccinology and the architecture of human immunity.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: Europe PMC flags show no open access, no PMCID, no supplement, no data or database cross-references, no text-mined accessions, no NCBI links (GEO/SRA/BioProject) and no Zenodo/Dryad hits for the DOI.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The abstract says outright 'Here we review the current state of the field of systems vaccinology'. It is a review article that reports no new measurements, so there is no dataset to open.

a1_downloadable.note: Review article with no deposited data: no accessions, supplement or repository records found (checked via Europe PMC and NCBI links). The datasets it discusses, such as the ImmuneSpace or HIPC (Human Immunology Project Consortium) vaccine cohorts, belong to other papers.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not assessable: there is no table. Any label, such as antibody titre after vaccination, would come from the primary studies, not this paper.

a3_inputs_present.note: No inputs exist in this paper.

a5_enough_rows.note: No data, so no rows to count.

honest_claim_h3: None. A review has no data a model could learn from.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use blood gene activity measured before or just after vaccination to predict how strong the later antibody response will be.
plain_idea.train_on: Would need gene-expression profiles from vaccinated people. This paper provides none, so the number of examples is unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Antibody level weeks after vaccination, measured by antibody assays in the primary cohort studies. None of these measurements are in this paper.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Vaccine developers could spot weak responders early. But this project belongs to the primary datasets (for example, HIPC cohorts in ImmuneSpace), not to this review.

ml_idea: None from this paper. The review points to primary systems-vaccinology cohorts (HIPC/ImmuneSpace, the CHI influenza studies) as data sources. Each of those would need its own evaluation.

effort.compute_note: No data, so nothing to estimate.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Read the abstract: it says this is a review. Done.

verdict_reason: Review article: it reports no new measurements, is paywalled with no PMC copy, and has no supplement, accessions or repository records. Fails A1.
